description: Ids of plays imported from ViTune or ViMusic backups (REWRITE §4.5.3): UUIDv5 of "videoId|timestampMs|playTimeMs" in the namespace NS_MELOGOLD_IMPORT = 4a3b8c8a-1d9c-48f2-938b-3077d54ab4fb, lower case. Every client computes the same id, so the same backup imported on two devices does not double the history.
